svg.title: ForgeOps security model
svg.desc: A hostile build sits inside four rings: the gVisor Sentry, cgroup limits, a network policy and the host kernel. Seven escape attempts each hit the ring that contains them.
svg.text: Assume every build is hostile. Contain it anyway.
ESCAPE SUITE · A DELIBERATELY HOSTILE REPO

text.tspan: no host mounts · FS goes through the gofer

svg.text: Call the control plane, Redis, Postgres

text.tspan: syscalls served by the Sentry, not the host

svg.text: Target: 7/7 contained, each one a test against a hostile repo (Phase 6). Nothing is measured yet.
